# TIDY Up
> TIDY Up (Townsville Illegal Dumping Yobo's Clean-ups) raises awareness of illegal dumping in Townsville, organises community clean-ups, and advocates for stronger action against environmental crime.

The site shares the mission of founder Dave Dudley: illegal dumping is a community problem, not only a council problem. TIDY Up encourages reporting, contacting elected representatives, and supporting transfer stations and dump vouchers in growth areas. Contact: tidytsv@gmail.com.

## Pages
- [Home](https://tidyup.work/): Mission statement, contact details, and related coverage of illegal dumping in Townsville

## Community
- [TIDY Up Townsville (Facebook group)](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1044042929275742/): Primary Facebook group for Townsville clean-ups and dumping reports
- [TIDY Up Townsville (Facebook page)](https://www.facebook.com/TidyUpTSV): Official Facebook page
- [TIDY Up Townsville (Instagram)](https://www.instagram.com/townsvilletidy/): Instagram updates from clean-ups and dumping hotspots
